title: The Golden Ladder: Golden Cuts from Plato to the Fourth Dimension
description: The Golden Ladder, Version 1, chapters 1 and 2. Chapter 1, One Triangle, Three Numbers: the five Platonic solids come from three kaleidoscopes, and these from one triangle with a single number in its corner, 1, √2 or φ, which decides where every golden cut can and cannot live. Chapter 2, Silence Is Golden (The Ladder of Multiplets): the sweep from the octahedron to the cube is the family of weight shapes of SU(4) and SO(7), and in four dimensions of SO(9); every golden solid of the sweeps is where a Fibonacci ladder of multiplets converges, and the first half of the sweep is one musical octave. Later chapters are added in new versions.
